meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.

table.title: Combined deficits of the central and state governments, per cent of GDP

meta.coverage: The general government's deficits as a share of GDP, 1981-82 to 2003-04, over GDP on the 1999-2000 base
meta.note: RBI, Combined deficits of the central and state governments, per cent of GDP (DBIE report 347). Per cent of GDP at current market prices, GDP on the 1999-2000 base (the RBI's note on its state-indicators table: 1999-2000 base to 2003-04, 2004-05 base to 2010-11, 2011-12 base from 2011-12; the Centre's and the combined tables divide by the same GDP, checked by their implied denominators). A different GDP base is a different ruler: never joined across bundles. Cross-checked against the printed table (Innovation Hub export of Handbook report 86): 135 of 135 figures match.
